== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Nayl Klaw Tuthan]] ([[Perdition Rock]])

== Notes ==
* The instant recharge provided by Glyph of Renewal overrides the effects of [[Diversion]] and [[Auspicious Incantation]].
* The instant recharge will occur even if the spell is [[interrupt]]ed.
* NPCs will use skills indiscriminately after invoking a Glyph of Renewal, not prioritizing spells with long cooldowns, nor delay those to invoke the Glyph first.
